description: The chart illustrates the accuracy and computational cost of different models, with the categories represented on the horizontal axis and labeled as CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, corresponding to red, blue, and green bars, respectively, while the orange bars represent an unspecified category. The vertical axes represent accuracy percentage on the left and an unspecified unit on the right, both with linear scales. The left axis ranges from 75 to 91.19 with a tick label interval of 5, and the right axis ranges from 0 to 676.85. The bars are grouped into three categories, with each group containing four bars of different colors. The accuracy values for CoD, CCoT, and CoUT are approximately 91.19%, 88.50%, and 88.40%, respectively, with the corresponding unspecified unit values being around 676.85, 445.91, and 354.46. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the colors are consistent across the groups, with the red bars being the tallest in both representations, and the orange bars having an accuracy of around 80.89% and an unspecified unit value of approximately 534.24. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized.
